title: Selectively visible lights over valley on Highway 40
place_text: Highway 40 en route to Bullhead City, Arizona

tellings.quote: Another time, um, my son and I were, uh, driving to our old vacation place in Bullhead City, Arizona, and we were on Highway 40, out in a remote area, and, um, I saw this, uh, this bright white light hovering over this valley about 5 or 10 miles away.

plain: While driving on Highway 40 through a remote area on the way to Bullhead City, Arizona, Steve Colbern saw a bright white light hovering over a valley five or ten miles away. Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells Michels he was with his son at the time and also names Garrett. The story is told as one about lights that only some people could see, which would mean the light could choose who saw it.
